The offer that made you buy twelve.
The Paper and Household Backstock in the Hall Closet. Keeps a reserve of paper goods, bulbs, and batteries so you never make a late-night emergency trip.

What done looks like:
1. Toilet roll in one clear bin with a card on the shelf edge reading "min 6
2. Max 24". Bulbs in a labeled bin sorted by fitting. Batteries standing in their original packs in a shallow tray
3. Sizes readable without lifting one out. Every bin label facing the door

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success paper and household backstock.
